text: A man in a bumping Ford rattled up beside her, hailed, “Give you a lift, Mrs. Kennicott?” “Thank you. It's awfully good of you, but I'm enjoying the walk.” “Great day, by golly. I seen some wheat that must of been five inches high. Well, so long.” She hadn't the dimmest notion who he was, but his greeting warmed her. This countryman gave her a companionship which she had never (whether by her fault or theirs or neither) been able to find in the matrons and commercial lords of the town.
